Name: Pool Table - CF
Author: BlatantDecoy
Description:
Available in Robin's shop, 3000 for the Pool Table, 100 for Pool Cues (customisable in the content.json), or through the furniture catalogue.

Note that this is just decorative furniture for the Custom Furniture mod and can not be used.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]Custom Furniture Mod[/url]
To place outdoors you require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2276]Furniture Anywhere[/url] & the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254?tab=files]Custom Furniture Anywhere[/url] addon.

Downloads.Description:
Place in StardewValley\Mods folder
Requires SMAPI & Custom Furniture

Manifest.Name: (CF) Pool Table
Manifest.Description: Adds the Saloon's Pool Table & Pool Cues as furniture.
